name: Kolb Learning Style Inventory
description: Ipsative learning style inventory for experiential learning classification.
instructions: Rank each group of four statements from 4 to 1. Use 4 for the statement that best describes you and 1 for the statement that least describes you. Do not repeat values in the same group.

questions.text: Rank the four statements according to how you usually learn. Group 1.

options.label: I learn through concrete experiences.
I learn by observing and reflecting.
I learn through concepts and explanations.
I learn by experimenting and applying ideas.
